punjab_cm_history.title: Our Chief Ministers
punjab_cm_history.publisher: Office of the Chief Minister, Punjab
punjab_cm_history.reviewed_excerpt: Punjab’s chief-minister history lists Parvez Elahi (PML-Q) from 2022-07-26 to 2023-01-22 and caretaker Mohsin Naqvi from 2023-01-22 to 2024-02-25. The separately cited oath record places Elahi’s oath on 2022-07-27. The history also lists Shahbaz Sharif, Hasan Askari Rizvi, Usman Buzdar, Hamza Shahbaz and Maryam Nawaz.

elahi_oath.title: President administers oath to Parvez Elahi
elahi_oath.publisher: Press Information Department, Government of Pakistan
elahi_oath.reviewed_excerpt: The Presidency records the chief minister oath on 27 July 2022. The CM history lists 26 July; this register uses the oath event and retains the discrepancy.

naqvi_oath.title: Mohsin Naqvi takes oath as caretaker Punjab CM
naqvi_oath.reviewed_excerpt: The Monday 23 January article reports the oath occurred Sunday night, 22 January. This matches the official CM history. Publication date is not used as the oath date.

caretaker_portfolios.title: Caretaker Punjab portfolios assigned
caretaker_portfolios.reviewed_excerpt: Javaid Akram is named for Specialized Healthcare, Jamal Nasir for Primary and Secondary Healthcare, and Mansoor Qadir for Higher and School Education. Ministers took oath the preceding day. Exact portfolio notification and end dates still need review.
